_comment: Hand-labeled ground truth, written before the judge was run on these traces. critical_step/category are null for traces with no injected failure (true-negative tests for false positives). notes explains what makes each trace a distinct test case.

stale_plan_tier.json.notes: Stale cached fact contradicted by a later tool result, never reconciled.

timezone_assumption.json.notes: Unchecked early assumption, explicitly contradicted by a tool result three steps later.

misread_units.json.notes: Tool result is correct (amount_cents); the agent misreads it as dollars. No stale/contradicted fact -- the error is a misinterpretation of a single correct value.

duplicate_entity_confusion.json.notes: Tool honestly reports two matching customers; the agent silently picks one without disambiguating.

compounding_rounding_error.json.notes: Hard case: an internal rounding decision causes a ~14% downstream error, but nothing in the trace explicitly contradicts it. Tests whether a judge designed to spot contradictions can catch an error with no contradiction to find.

misattributed_source.json.notes: Two retrieved documents conflict; the agent relies on the one marked legacy/superseded instead of the current one it already has.

outdated_permission_role.json.notes: Stale cached role; compounded by misreading the audit log result that later contradicts it.

silent_wrong_default.json.notes: Tool transparently reports it applied a default (via a note field); the agent doesn't register the note and treats the result as valid.

clean_success_refund.json.notes: True negative: task completed correctly, nothing contradicted.

clean_success_flight.json.notes: True negative: task completed correctly, nothing contradicted.
